summary.note: seed means include finite-grouping averaging error (expected SD pooled/sqrt(k)); the variance component max(0, Var(seed means) - pooled^2/k) is a descriptive, highly uncertain estimate with 3 seeds

hierarchical_bootstrap.note: only 3 allocation seeds: the outer resampling has very few distinct configurations (10); the interval is unstable and descriptive, not population-level inference

uncertainty_levels.window_bootstrap: evaluation-text sampling uncertainty CONDITIONAL on one fixed pair of quantized models (s, g)
uncertainty_levels.grouping_replication: sensitivity to calibration execution conditions (BF16 batch membership) within a seed
uncertainty_levels.allocation_seeds: variation in the selected calibration sets (only 3 seeds: outer unit)
uncertainty_levels.combination: not combined into a single interval; the hierarchical bootstrap covers seeds and groupings only, with the evaluation windows held fixed

pseudoreplication_note: the 15 Delta[s,g] are NOT 15 independent replicates: groupings are nested within 3 allocation seeds; no flat 15-observation bootstrap is used
